story: The SpaceX Starship is a big deal
text: Curiosity used aerobraking, parachutes AND a skycrane to land. There's a great video here: [VIDEO] Previous solutions weren't used because they were less crazy, but because they were more mass efficient for "small" payload sizes.

story: NASA's Perseverance rover will attempt to land on Mars this week
text: JPL produced a video titled "7 minutes of terror" that detailed the landing procedure they used for Curiosity, and it's worth a watch. It goes into detail on everything you see in the articles landing video: [VIDEO]

story: Breaks Observed in Rover Wheel Treads
text: Surprisingly the wheels only weigh a few pounds each! (I still can't think in metric and I don't have a real number.) They were primarily constrained by packing volume during cruise ( [LINK] ) and then by shock loads as the securing pyrobolts blew during landing ( [VIDEO] ).

story: Hubble Space Telescope Is In Safe Mode After Gyro Failure

story: NASA's Curiosity rover: 3k days on Mars
text: For perceiving the events happening, sure, that was my point. These time differences are nearly always imperceptible but at distances of planets it truly becomes a way of looking into the past.
